analysis.narrativeEn:

· Position relative to SMA100 ($0.21)/SMA200 ($0.21): below long-term averages, maintaining bearish strength.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI 39.7 → 33.4 (attempting to exit oversold): entered oversold territory, exploring rebound potential.
· MACD histogram -0.0008 → -0.0010 (worsening): bearish trend persists, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (lower band $0.17): approaching lower band, potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.17): based on 5-day low and Bollinger lower band.
· Swing resistance ($0.18): aligned with current price, short-term resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low formed/sideways): lack of trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.96x): moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): RSI attempting to exit oversold but MACD worsening, maintaining wait-and-see condition.
